route: every secondary button (e.g. /inbox 'Mark all seen', /projects 'New project', /settings 'Save changes')
action: Read the computed colour and background of the button label and compute the WCAG contrast ratio.
observed: 4.40:1 — color oklab(0.55 -0.0035 -0.0187) on background oklab(0.966 -0.0010 -0.0049), font-size 13px, weight 500.
repro: Open /inbox, /projects or /settings and measure any secondary button's label against its surface.
evidence: computed styles read live on five pages; ratio computed from canvas-resolved sRGB values
note: One token issue, not five bugs. Dark theme not measured.

action: Read the heading sequence of the rendered page.
observed: H1 then H3 with no H2 anywhere on the page (headingSkips 1->3).
evidence: a11y() headingOrder/headingSkips on /materials; /, /inbox, /projects, /experiments/new and /settings are clean

expected: No validation error on a pristine field.
observed: The email field renders aria-invalid and 'Enter an email address.' at open time, before any input.
repro: Open the invite dialog and read the field's aria-invalid and helper text.

action: Read the shell's top bar and drawer composition.
expected: A phone user can see and change the active workspace.
observed: The switcher is hidden sm:flex and the drawer no longer exists below 1024px, so below 640px there is no workspace control; the component comment still describes the drawer as carrying it.
repro: Open any route at 390px and look for a workspace control.

action: Read the CSV export and the log query.
expected: A download that survives the click, and access to the whole log.
observed: The blob URL is revoked synchronously after a.click() on a detached anchor (fragile outside Chromium) with no stated failure; the log is capped at the most recent 200 events with no pagination, and the export inherits that window.

action: Read the document registry and the route.
expected: A valid document name renders the document; an unknown name renders the friendly message.
observed: All six whitelisted documents are missing from the repository, so every valid name renders 'not available'; an unknown name throws a bare Error.
evidence: the docs route and its whitelist

action: Read the routes and their inbound links.
expected: Dev-only surfaces are marked as such.
observed: They render full product chrome with no marker and no inbound links; /foundations prose still calls the retired legacy chrome 'the live shell'.

action: Clicked the header 'New project' button and diffed the DOM before and after, twice, on an idle machine.
observed: The URL becomes /projects?new=true and nothing opens: dialog/popover nodes 0 before and 0 after, no name field appears, the list is unchanged. The button is enabled (its disabled={!canCreate} guard is satisfied) and the dialog gate is open={canCreate && !!search.new} with the click setting exactly that param.
repro: Open /projects, click New project, wait 4s, look for a dialog.

action: Tabbed through the form and recorded the focus order.
expected: Every tab stop is a named, visible control.
observed: Two stops landed on elements with no accessible name and no visible outline.
note: Plausibly base-ui's hidden inputs (aria-hidden, tabindex=-1) behind styled controls — the same pattern that produced 14 false positives on /projects. Not verified either way.
